title: Zero Forcing in Generalized Petersen Graphs
headline: The mathematical proof of $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge 13$ has passed an independent hostile audit; Lean formalisation is the next active phase.
description: Research on the zero-forcing number of the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$. The imported computational pilot and baseline were reproduced, and the exact quantified mathematical proof has now passed an independent hostile audit. Lean formalisation is next; Palomar verification and publication work have not begun.
verification: Computational baseline reproduced; independent mathematical proof audit passed; Lean formalisation pending.
attribution: The target is Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 preprint A correction to the Zero Forcing Number of the Generalized Petersen Graphs P(n,3) (arXiv:2607.19412v1). John Fairfax-Ball's repository reproduced the imported computational baseline and independently audited the candidate proof; it does not claim authorship of the underlying conjecture.
